requests.title: requests
requests.description: resource requests; cpu and memory are required

limits.title: limits
limits.description: resource limits; memory is required (a cpu limit is optional)

service.title: Service
service.description: the ClusterIP Service in front of the pods

port.title: Service port
port.description: port of the ClusterIP Service (targets the container's http port)

nameOverride.title: name override
nameOverride.description: replaces the chart name in resource names and the app.kubernetes.io/name label

fullnameOverride.title: full name override
fullnameOverride.description: replaces <release>-<chart> as the base of every resource name

image.title: backend image
image.description: the proreta-backend image (api, worker, jobs, statuspage, migrate, bootstrap Jobs)

repository.title: backend image repository
repository.description: registry and repository of the backend image

tag.title: backend image tag
tag.description: a release version (X.Y.Z; a leading v such as v1.2.3 is rejected, image tags have none) or a main-branch build (sha-<7 hex>); empty uses the chart appVersion, which only a chart from oci://ghcr.io/proreta-io/charts/proreta has (rendering fails in a git checkout)

imagePullSecrets.title: image pull secrets
imagePullSecrets.description: Secrets for a private registry or mirror, e.g. [{name: registry-pull}]

name.title: pull secret name
name.description: name of a docker-registry Secret in the release namespace

config.title: application configuration
config.description: environment contract read by the backend

adminPort.title: admin port
adminPort.description: PRORETA_ADMIN_ADDR port (health and metrics) of every backend pod; never routed externally

sessionTTL.title: session TTL
sessionTTL.description: PRORETA_SESSION_TTL, a Go duration such as 24h (api only)

cookieSecure.title: secure cookies
cookieSecure.description: PRORETA_COOKIE_SECURE (api and statuspage); keep true, sign-in needs https

trustedProxyHops.title: trusted proxy hops
trustedProxyHops.description: PRORETA_TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS: number of trusted proxies in front of the api; 0 if none, 1 behind one Gateway

registrationEnabled.title: self-service registration
registrationEnabled.description: PRORETA_REGISTRATION_ENABLED: anyone can create an organization, without email verification (chart default false)

passwordLoginEnabled.title: password login
passwordLoginEnabled.description: PRORETA_PASSWORD_LOGIN_ENABLED: false keeps the password form for the platform admin only and needs an OAuth provider (default true)

publicUrl.title: public URL
publicUrl.description: PRORETA_PUBLIC_URL, required: the https URL users open, for example https://proreta.example.com; https only, no trailing slash, no user info, query or link-breaking characters; its host is the default of httpRoute.hostnames

blockedCIDRs.title: blocked CIDRs
blockedCIDRs.description: PRORETA_BLOCKED_CIDRS: extra ranges the SSRF guard refuses (api, worker, jobs), for example the cluster and VPC CIDRs

database.title: database
database.description: the PostgreSQL server and the Secret with the connection URLs; one PostgreSQL server hosts one installation (fixed role names)

secretName.title: database Secret name
secretName.description: Secret with the connection URLs (keys api_url, worker_url, owner_url, statuspage_url); empty: <fullname>-db. Created by the bootstrap Job, or by you when bootstrap is disabled

host.title: database host
host.description: PostgreSQL server host reachable from the cluster; required when database.bootstrap.enabled

name.title: database name
name.description: name of the database the bootstrap creates

sslmode.title: sslmode
sslmode.description: libpq sslmode of the connections; require encrypts without verifying the certificate

bootstrap.title: database bootstrap
bootstrap.description: hook Job that creates the database, the roles and the database Secret; turn it off after the first successful install

enabled.title: run the database bootstrap
enabled.description: render the bootstrap hook Job; it holds the database server admin login while enabled

adminSecret.title: database admin login
adminSecret.description: where the bootstrap reads the database server admin login (LOGIN, CREATEROLE, CREATEDB)

existingSecret.title: existing admin Secret
existingSecret.description: a Secret you created in the release namespace with the login; when set no ExternalSecret is rendered

remoteKey.title: admin remote key
remoteKey.description: with externalSecrets.enabled and existingSecret empty: the JSON secret in your store

usernameKey.title: username key
usernameKey.description: key of the admin user name in the Secret (and property of the remote secret)

passwordKey.title: password key
passwordKey.description: key of the admin password in the Secret (and property of the remote secret)

backoffLimit.title: database bootstrap backoffLimit
backoffLimit.description: retries of the database bootstrap Job before it fails

activeDeadlineSeconds.title: database bootstrap activeDeadlineSeconds
activeDeadlineSeconds.description: maximum run time of the database bootstrap Job in seconds

ttlSecondsAfterFinished.title: database bootstrap ttlSecondsAfterFinished
ttlSecondsAfterFinished.description: seconds a finished database bootstrap Job is kept (its logs stay readable until then)

resources.title: database bootstrap Job resources
resources.description: Kubernetes requests and limits of the database bootstrap Job container; requests.cpu, requests.memory and limits.memory are required

secrets.title: generated or external Secrets
secrets.description: admin login, encryption keys, status page cookie key and OAuth client credentials

admin.title: admin Secret
admin.description: Secret <fullname>-admin (login, password_hash) of the platform admin

source.title: source
source.description: who creates the Secret: generate (the secrets bootstrap Job, default) or externalSecret (read from remoteKey through External Secrets; needs externalSecrets.enabled)

remoteKey.title: admin remote key
remoteKey.description: externalSecret mode: JSON secret with properties login, password_hash

crypto.title: encryption key Secret
crypto.description: Secret <fullname>-crypto (keys, active_key_id) that encrypts the Slack webhook URLs

source.title: source
source.description: who creates the Secret: generate (the secrets bootstrap Job, default) or externalSecret (read from remoteKey through External Secrets; needs externalSecrets.enabled)

keyId.title: key id
keyId.description: id of the generated key (generate mode), PRORETA_ENCRYPTION_ACTIVE_KEY_ID

remoteKey.title: crypto remote key
remoteKey.description: externalSecret mode: JSON secret with properties keys (JSON string), active_key_id

statuspage.title: status page cookie key Secret
statuspage.description: Secret <fullname>-statuspage (cookie_key) of the status page renderer; only with statuspage.enabled

source.title: source
source.description: who creates the Secret: generate (the secrets bootstrap Job, default) or externalSecret (read from remoteKey through External Secrets; needs externalSecrets.enabled)

remoteKey.title: status page remote key
remoteKey.description: externalSecret mode: JSON secret with property cookie_key (standard base64 of 32 random bytes)

oauth.title: OAuth client credentials
oauth.description: a Secret you created (existingSecret) or, with externalSecrets.enabled, the ExternalSecret <fullname>-oauth read from remoteKey

existingSecret.title: existing OAuth Secret
existingSecret.description: Secret in the release namespace with google_client_id, google_client_secret, github_client_id, github_client_secret (only those of enabled providers); when set no ExternalSecret is rendered

remoteKey.title: OAuth remote key
remoteKey.description: JSON secret in your store, used when existingSecret is empty

bootstrap.title: secrets bootstrap Job
bootstrap.description: hook Job that generates the Secrets whose source is generate; it has no database credentials

backoffLimit.title: secrets bootstrap backoffLimit
backoffLimit.description: retries of the secrets bootstrap Job before it fails

activeDeadlineSeconds.title: secrets bootstrap activeDeadlineSeconds
activeDeadlineSeconds.description: maximum run time of the secrets bootstrap Job in seconds

ttlSecondsAfterFinished.title: secrets bootstrap ttlSecondsAfterFinished
ttlSecondsAfterFinished.description: seconds a finished secrets bootstrap Job is kept (its logs stay readable until then)

resources.title: secrets bootstrap Job resources
resources.description: Kubernetes requests and limits of the secrets bootstrap Job container; requests.cpu, requests.memory and limits.memory are required

smtp.title: SMTP password
smtp.description: a Secret you created (existingSecret) or, with externalSecrets.enabled, the ExternalSecret <fullname>-smtp read from remoteKey; only read with email.enabled and email.smtp.username

existingSecret.title: existing SMTP Secret
existingSecret.description: Secret in the release namespace with key password; when set no ExternalSecret is rendered

remoteKey.title: SMTP remote key
remoteKey.description: JSON secret in your store with property password, used when existingSecret is empty

oauth.title: OAuth sign-in
oauth.description: OAuth sign-in providers; credentials come from secrets.oauth

allowedDomains.title: allowed Workspace domains
allowedDomains.description: PRORETA_OAUTH_ALLOWED_DOMAINS: lowercase Google Workspace domains organizations may claim for auto-join; empty turns claiming off

externalSecrets.title: External Secrets
externalSecrets.description: External Secrets Operator integration (optional, off by default)

enabled.title: External Secrets enabled
enabled.description: render ExternalSecrets (needs the operator and its CRDs in the cluster)

apiVersion.title: ExternalSecret apiVersion
apiVersion.description: API version of the rendered ExternalSecrets

secretStoreRef.title: secret store
secretStoreRef.description: the SecretStore or ClusterSecretStore the ExternalSecrets read from

name.title: store name
name.description: name of the store; required when enabled

refreshInterval.title: refresh interval
refreshInterval.description: refreshInterval of the ExternalSecrets; "0" reads once

podAnnotations.title: pod annotations
podAnnotations.description: annotations added to every pod of the Deployments

podLabels.title: pod labels
podLabels.description: labels added to every pod of the Deployments (never to selectors)

tolerations.title: tolerations
tolerations.description: tolerations of every pod (Kubernetes Toleration objects)

affinity.title: affinity
affinity.description: affinity of every pod (a Kubernetes Affinity object)

podSecurityContext.title: pod security context
podSecurityContext.description: pod securityContext of every pod (a Kubernetes PodSecurityContext); the default meets the restricted Pod Security Standard; overriding it can break the restricted profile

securityContext.title: container security context
securityContext.description: securityContext of every container (a Kubernetes SecurityContext); the default meets the restricted Pod Security Standard; overriding it can break the restricted profile

maxSurge.title: max surge
maxSurge.description: pods above the desired count during a rollout (number or percentage)

maxUnavailable.title: max unavailable
maxUnavailable.description: pods below the desired count during a rollout (number or percentage)

annotations.title: ServiceAccount annotations
annotations.description: annotations of every ServiceAccount, for example for workload identity

replicas.title: api replicas
replicas.description: number of api pods; stateless, login rate limits are per replica

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.title: api termination grace period
terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: terminationGracePeriodSeconds of the api pods; default: the top-level terminationGracePeriodSeconds

resources.title: api resources
resources.description: Kubernetes requests and limits of the api container; requests.cpu, requests.memory and limits.memory are required

env.title: extra api env
env.description: extra environment variables of the api container (a list of Kubernetes EnvVar objects, for example {name: FOO, value: bar}); appended after the chart's own

enabled.title: PDB enabled
enabled.description: render a PodDisruptionBudget for the api

minAvailable.title: min available
minAvailable.description: minAvailable of the PodDisruptionBudget (number or percentage)

replicas.title: worker replicas
replicas.description: number of worker pods; they share the due checks through database leases

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.title: worker termination grace period
terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: terminationGracePeriodSeconds of the worker pods; default: the top-level terminationGracePeriodSeconds

concurrency.title: concurrency
concurrency.description: PRORETA_WORKER_CONCURRENCY: checks in flight per pod

tenantConcurrency.title: tenant concurrency
tenantConcurrency.description: PRORETA_WORKER_TENANT_CONCURRENCY: checks in flight per organization

hostConcurrency.title: host concurrency
hostConcurrency.description: PRORETA_WORKER_HOST_CONCURRENCY: checks in flight per target host

location.title: probe location
location.description: PRORETA_WORKER_LOCATION: code of the probe location whose checks this worker runs (a DNS label; the database is seeded with default)

resources.title: worker resources
resources.description: Kubernetes requests and limits of the worker container; requests.cpu, requests.memory and limits.memory are required

env.title: extra worker env
env.description: extra environment variables of the worker container (a list of Kubernetes EnvVar objects, for example {name: FOO, value: bar}); appended after the chart's own

replicas.title: jobs replicas
replicas.description: 0 or 1 only: jobs must stay a singleton; 0 stops Slack delivery and housekeeping

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.title: jobs termination grace period
terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: terminationGracePeriodSeconds of the jobs pods; default: the top-level terminationGracePeriodSeconds

resources.title: jobs resources
resources.description: Kubernetes requests and limits of the jobs container; requests.cpu, requests.memory and limits.memory are required

env.title: extra jobs env
env.description: extra environment variables of the jobs container (a list of Kubernetes EnvVar objects, for example {name: FOO, value: bar}); appended after the chart's own

statuspage.title: statuspage
statuspage.description: the public status page renderer (Deployment <fullname>-statuspage), routed at /status

enabled.title: status pages enabled
enabled.description: deploy the renderer and route /status to it

replicas.title: statuspage replicas
replicas.description: number of renderer pods; rate limits and cache are per replica

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.title: statuspage termination grace period
terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: terminationGracePeriodSeconds of the statuspage pods; default: the top-level terminationGracePeriodSeconds

resources.title: statuspage resources
resources.description: Kubernetes requests and limits of the statuspage container; requests.cpu, requests.memory and limits.memory are required

env.title: extra statuspage env
env.description: extra environment variables of the statuspage container (a list of Kubernetes EnvVar objects, for example {name: FOO, value: bar}); appended after the chart's own

web.title: web
web.description: the web app (nginx serving the React build, Deployment <fullname>-web), routed at /

enabled.title: web enabled
enabled.description: deploy the web app and route / to it (default true)

repository.title: web image repository
repository.description: registry and repository of the web image

tag.title: web image tag
tag.description: empty: the backend image tag (both images are released together)

httpPort.title: web HTTP port
httpPort.description: container port; must be the port nginx listens on (8080 in the published image)

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.title: web termination grace period
terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: terminationGracePeriodSeconds of the web pods; default: the top-level terminationGracePeriodSeconds

resources.title: web resources
resources.description: Kubernetes requests and limits of the web container; requests.cpu, requests.memory and limits.memory are required

env.title: extra web env
env.description: extra environment variables of the web container (a list of Kubernetes EnvVar objects, for example {name: FOO, value: bar}); appended after the chart's own

migration.title: database migration
migration.description: hook Job <fullname>-migrate that applies the migrations as proreta_owner before the workloads start

hookPhase.title: ArgoCD hook phase
hookPhase.description: Sync (default, ordered by waves) or PreSync (ArgoCD only; not with database.bootstrap.enabled)

backoffLimit.title: migration backoffLimit
backoffLimit.description: retries of the migration Job before it fails

activeDeadlineSeconds.title: migration activeDeadlineSeconds
activeDeadlineSeconds.description: maximum run time of the migration Job in seconds

ttlSecondsAfterFinished.title: migration ttlSecondsAfterFinished
ttlSecondsAfterFinished.description: seconds a finished migration Job is kept (its logs stay readable until then)

resources.title: migration Job resources
resources.description: Kubernetes requests and limits of the migration Job container; requests.cpu, requests.memory and limits.memory are required

httpRoute.title: HTTPRoute
httpRoute.description: Gateway API routing: /api to the api, /status to the statuspage, / to the web

enabled.title: HTTPRoute enabled
enabled.description: render the HTTPRoute; false: route to the Services yourself

hostnames.title: host names
hostnames.description: host names of the route; empty: the host of config.publicUrl

items.description: lowercase DNS name, optionally with one leading *. wildcard label

parentRef.title: Gateway
parentRef.description: the Gateway (and its HTTPS listener) the HTTPRoute attaches to

name.title: Gateway name
name.description: name of your Gateway; required when httpRoute.enabled

namespace.title: Gateway namespace
namespace.description: namespace of the Gateway; empty: the release namespace

sectionName.title: listener name
sectionName.description: listener (sectionName) on the Gateway; empty attaches to every listener that admits the route

apiPathPrefix.title: api path prefix
apiPathPrefix.description: path prefix routed to the api

apiRequestTimeout.title: api request timeout
apiRequestTimeout.description: Gateway API request timeout of the api rule, for example 60s

statusPathPrefix.title: status path prefix
statusPathPrefix.description: path prefix routed to the statuspage; fixed to /status (the renderer serves only that)

networkPolicy.title: NetworkPolicy
networkPolicy.description: optional ingress NetworkPolicy; effective only when the CNI enforces NetworkPolicy

gatewayNamespace.title: Gateway proxy namespace
gatewayNamespace.description: namespace of the Gateway's proxy pods allowed to reach api, web and statuspage; empty: httpRoute.parentRef.namespace, else the release namespace

monitoringNamespace.title: monitoring namespace
monitoringNamespace.description: namespace allowed to scrape the admin port

serviceMonitor.title: ServiceMonitor
serviceMonitor.description: optional Prometheus Operator ServiceMonitor for the backend admin ports

enabled.title: ServiceMonitor enabled
enabled.description: render the ServiceMonitor and the metrics Services (needs the Prometheus Operator CRDs)

labels.title: ServiceMonitor labels
labels.description: extra labels of the ServiceMonitor, for example the selector of your Prometheus

topologyKey.title: topology key
topologyKey.description: node label to spread over, for example kubernetes.io/hostname

email.title: outgoing email
email.description: optional outgoing email through an SMTP server; off by default and then nothing is emailed

enabled.title: email enabled
enabled.description: queue and deliver email (PRORETA_SMTP_*); needs email.smtp.host and email.smtp.from

host.title: SMTP host
host.description: PRORETA_SMTP_HOST: server name or address without a port; required when email is enabled

port.title: SMTP port
port.description: PRORETA_SMTP_PORT; 0 takes the default of the TLS mode (587 starttls, 465 tls, 25 none)

tls.title: SMTP TLS mode
tls.description: PRORETA_SMTP_TLS: starttls, tls (implicit) or none (localhost only)

from.title: sender address
from.description: PRORETA_SMTP_FROM: address or "Name <address>"; required when email is enabled

username.title: SMTP username
username.description: PRORETA_SMTP_USERNAME; empty means no login. The password comes from secrets.smtp
